morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语整词借入，现代马来语中不再拆分；标准音位形式保留 /i/ 和词尾 /b/，部分口语读音出现元音降低及词尾清化。

word_family.gloss: 义务；职责，派生形式中 b 变为 p

senses.zh_definition: 伊斯兰教法中的必行义务类别：履行可获善功，无正当理由而故意不履行则有罪责。
senses.en_definition: An Islamic legal category of obligation, whose fulfilment is rewarded and whose deliberate neglect without valid excuse incurs sin.
senses.ms_definition: Kategori hukum Islam yang menetapkan sesuatu tuntutan mesti ditunaikan; pelaksanaannya diberi pahala dan pengabaiannya tanpa keuzuran membawa dosa.
senses.nuances: 用于教法分类，如 hukum wajib。具体适用条件及豁免须依有关教法规定判断。[DBP：wajib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=wajib)

collocations.zh: 宗教上必须履行的事项

senses.zh_definition: 必须；因规定、要求或责任而不可省略地。
senses.en_definition: Necessarily or compulsorily, because a rule, requirement, or duty demands it.
senses.ms_definition: Mesti dilakukan atau dipatuhi kerana ditetapkan oleh peraturan, keperluan atau tanggungjawab.
senses.nuances: 不限于宗教，常用于学校、工作及行政要求。口语 wajib cuba 可夸张地表示“绝对要试试”，并非真正强制。[DBP：wajib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=wajib)

collocations.en: required to wear a seat belt

senses.zh_definition: 理应；基于道德、情理或感恩而应当。
senses.en_definition: As a matter of moral duty or proper conduct; ought to.
senses.ms_definition: Sepatutnya dilakukan berdasarkan pertimbangan moral, kepatutan atau penghargaan.
senses.nuances: 表达说话者认为应尽的责任，未必对应成文规定。[DBP：wajib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=wajib)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua peserta wajib menghadiri taklimat keselamatan sebelum memasuki kawasan kerja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 所有参与者进入作业区前，必须参加安全说明会。
dual_scenarios.en: All participants must attend the safety briefing before entering the work area.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Taklimat esok tu wajib ke? Aku nak uruskan hal lain pagi tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah taklimat esok itu wajib dihadiri? Saya hendak menguruskan perkara lain pada pagi itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 明天那个说明会一定要去吗？我那天早上还想办点别的事。
dual_scenarios.en: Is tomorrow's briefing compulsory? I was hoping to take care of something else that morning.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Taklimat esok tu wajib ke? Aku nak uruskan hal lain pagi tu.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah taklimat esok itu wajib dihadiri? Saya hendak menguruskan perkara lain pada pagi itu.
messages.zh: 明天那个说明会一定要去吗？我那天早上还想办点别的事。
messages.en: Is tomorrow's briefing compulsory? I was hoping to take care of something else that morning.

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, wajib. Bos dah pesan semua kena datang.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, taklimat itu wajib dihadiri. Ketua sudah berpesan bahawa semua orang mesti datang.
messages.zh: 对，必须去。老板已经交代了，大家都得来。
messages.en: Yes, it is. The boss has already said everyone has to be there.

etymology.historical_story: Wajib is an Arabic borrowing associated with obligation. In Malay religious discourse, it names a category of acts that believers must perform. Its everyday use also covers compulsory attendance and other requirements. This connection makes the word memorable: the same expression can signal religious duty, institutional necessity, or a strongly felt moral responsibility. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=24348&keyword=wajib)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 wa-jib 时，想象通知上盖着“必须”印章：wajib hadir＝必须出席；wajib 做的事，不能随便略过。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 对下属或公众使用 wajib 语气明确而有约束力。普通邀请若希望保留选择空间，可改用 dijemput 或 digalakkan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 宗教语境中应尊重其教法含义；介绍个人偏好时，wajib cuba 通常只是热情推荐，应结合语境理解。
